## Definition
A concept where sensing and computing architectures integrate data across land, sea, air, space, and cyber domains to create a holistic operational picture. Guides TCC/iNEST design to support multi-domain data flows and topology-aware routing, ensuring coherent situational understanding across heterogeneous networks.
